reference.title: Phishing Warning Signs
reference.shortdesc: Information on what warning signs to look for that mean an email may be a scam.

strow.stentry: Any unfamiliar or slightly misspelled sender addresses
An address that looks official but has a small misspelling. Even an @ncsu.edu address can be phishing.
Subject lines that say things are on hold or accounts will be closed like "We'll close your NCSU ID"
Any request for your login, financial, or personal information
Asking for your password or two-factor bypass codes. NC State IT will never ask for these.
Any link that doesn't lead you to where it says it will
Hovering shows a different address, or a login page doesn't start with shib.ncsu.edu.
A free retirement benefits consultation, or a payroll or pension review.
